criteria.criterion: Optional strict .spec-flow.json `validation` is opt-in, rejects unknown/invalid/unsafe keys, preserves prior behavior when omitted, and applies to every discovered spec (including ignored/legacy) before the legacy compatibility continue.
criteria.evidence: project-profile.mjs parseValidation uses assertExactKeys over exactly requiredFields/kindField/allowedKinds/numericFileId/checkDoneCheckboxes/forbidAddendumFilename/dependencyIntegrity, enforces SAFE_FIELD/FORBIDDEN_KEYS on requiredFields, boolean types, and kindField distinctness (configured-lifecycle branch checks all metadata fields). core.mjs projectContractProblems returns [] when rules are null, and checkCI pushes its problems immediately after the unknown-status branch and before `if (role === "ignored") continue;`. project-contracts.test.mjs proves no-profile no-op plus rejected unknown key, __proto__, non-boolean. Impl evidence run shows the whole suite green.

criteria.criterion: numericFileId (safe-integer id matching N.*.md basename), checkDoneCheckboxes (root-level `- [ ]` for done), and dependencyIntegrity (safe non-negative integer arrays, existing targets, arbitrary-length cycle detection) fail closed.
criteria.evidence: core.mjs projectContractProblems validates basename with /^([0-9]+)\.[^/]+\.md$/ against Number.isSafeInteger(id), scans body after frontmatter for /^- \[ \]/gm when statusRole is done, and enforces integer/non-negative dependency arrays; projectDependencyProblems builds the id graph and DFS-detects cycles of any length. project-contracts.test.mjs asserts id/filename mismatch, addendum filename, missing target id 777, and the 4→5→6→4 cycle; impl records the targeted suite passing.

criteria.criterion: `check --ci --contracts-only` performs the same contract/evidence checks but never runs project gates and labels that omission; bare `check --ci` still runs all gates without caching; malformed/duplicate CLI flags fail closed; a verify script calling contracts-only cannot recurse.
criteria.evidence: checkCI(runProjectGates:false) pushes the contracts-only warning and skips runGates, and bare check uses runGates(cacheTtlMs:0). main() rejects any check flag not in {--ci,--contracts-only,--live} and duplicates. project-contracts.test.mjs and tests/e2e/e2e-private-action.mjs show contracts-only leaving no gate marker while full CI does, plus unknown-flag failure; e2e gate marker 'verify\n' proves a single non-recursive invocation.

criteria.criterion: Re-implementation invalidates stale impl/audit/attestation evidence and persists a pending non-passing impl before gates, preserving base_sha; a failed/interrupted gate cannot leave old pass evidence current; a tracked deletion preserves the content snapshot across commit.
criteria.evidence: core.mjs implUnlocked resets fm.impl to pending (pass:false, at:null, null hash fields), deletes fm.audit/attestations, and writes that before runGates, keeping fm.impl.base_sha. project-profile.test.mjs 'changed contract can re-impl when verify runs contracts-only' covers old-hash invalidation and a failing verify (old success cannot survive); workspace-project.test.mjs covers cancelled impl leaving impl.pass=false. repositorySnapshotHash now contributes nothing for actually-deleted paths and hashes gitlink paths after stat, with the staged-git-rm → commit equality regression in trustworthy.test.mjs.

criteria.criterion: Composite action.yml installs spec-flow's locked deps from its own checkout, hands the Action-local CLI path to a contracts-first verify, uses no PAT/privileged checkout/arbitrary shell, documents full-SHA caller pinning, and propagates gate failures once.
criteria.evidence: action.yml is composite: step 1 `cd "$ACTION_ROOT" && npm ci --omit=dev --omit=peer --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund` with ACTION_ROOT=${{ github.action_path }}; step 2 runs `node "$SPECFLOW_CLI" verify` with SPECFLOW_CLI=${{ github.action_path }}/core.mjs. No secrets/checkout/publish/deploy. action.test.mjs asserts this shape and absence of privileged references. checkCI(preferVerify) runs gates only when contracts are error-free and otherwise labels 'verify 项目门禁未运行', preserving bare check --ci all-gates diagnostics; tests/e2e/e2e-private-action.mjs proves invalid docs/profile stop before the gate marker and a nonzero caller gate runs exactly once. README documents same-account Access, two-repo ordering, full-SHA pins and the local-only claim before remote setup.

criteria.criterion: Full authoritative gate (syntax/unit/seven E2E groups/contracts-only) and real local CLI/Action-equivalent acceptance are archived with source-bound logs, and the implementation record is snapshot/contract bound.
criteria.evidence: package.json `check` runs typecheck+syntax, unit tests, seven real E2E groups and `check --ci --contracts-only`. docs/reviews/S1.5/full-check.log (tracked) is a complete Node 22.19.0 run: 161/161 tests, all seven E2E groups, terminal contracts-only pass and no errors; targeted.log records 8/8 targeted units plus 5 real copied-CLI Action-equivalent PASS; pre-fix.log preserves the pre-repair caller-gate ordering FAIL; github evidence, dependency-audit.json (0 runtime vulns), pi-smoke.log and secret-scan.md are archived. The recorded impl has pass:true with snapshot_hash becfa81d… and contract_hash 2ac91779…, matching the supplied audit bindings.

findings.evidence: In the default-lifecycle branch of parseConfiguredProfile the collision guard is only `validation?.kindField === DEFAULT_PROFILE.lifecycle.dependenciesField`, whereas the configured-lifecycle branch compares kindField against dependenciesField/updatedField/reviewersField/reviewedAtField. A default-profile config with kindField='updated' (or 'status'/'id') is therefore accepted, so the full 'colliding keys' rejection is not uniform. Impact is fail-closed rather than a bypass (lifecycle writes would then invalidate the spec), so this is a low-priority hardening item, not a product blocker.

out_of_scope: Remote execution of the current local endpoint (post-published-f842 local guard) is not independently statically verifiable; the supplied read-only GitHub artifacts cover the earlier published f842 endpoint and the owner's push/settings steps remain explicit user actions.
Closed S1.6/S1.7 lifecycle evidence and their review journals are not re-adjudicated here; only insofar as shared modules affect S1.5 contract guarantees.
Proposal feasibility verdict and the exhausted original S1.5 cycle are treated as history, not as this audit's acceptance.
